newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin falls in line with London's drop.
newsitem.headline: KL tin falls in line with London's drop.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia closed eight cents lower at 14.64 ringgit ($5.89) a kg after a lower London Metal Exchange (LME) sparked off large initial sellings.
Traders said there was an opening offer of 120 tonnes against bid of 60 tonnes. Turnover was 100 tonnes, against 126 on Thursday, with buying mainly from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.

"The market is likely to fluctuate between 14.50 and 14.75 in the near-term. The trend also depends on the LME," a trader said. The local price differential to London widened to $35 a tonne premium from $20 previously.
